description: Urban Development Authority - Notice of approval of the Development Plan for the Mannar Urban Council Area and Pradeshiya Sabha Area
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Mahinda Rajapaksa) and detailed descriptions of his ministerial portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Urban Development and Housing). It also references specific legal powers vested in him under Section 8(F) of the Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, making it a hybrid document that includes both personnel information and detailed governmental responsibilities.
